description: CSS injection via the style attribute on span/pre (HIGH-1): position overlays, background:url() exfiltration, expression()/behavior/-moz-binding script vectors, comment-hidden declarations. The sanitizer allow-lists the style attribute (KaTeX needs layout properties) but filters every declaration to a strict safe-property allow-list, so dangerous capabilities are stripped while safe layout properties survive. Structural safety is asserted by the absence of the dangerous CSS capabilities from the output; the only surviving style declarations are trusted layout values.
